import sys

def add(x, y):
    tmp = x + y
    mod = 1000000007
    return tmp - mod if tmp >= mod else tmp

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    dp = [0] * (n + 2)
    dp[0] = 1
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    while i <= n:
        j = i
        while j <= n:
            if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
                ans = add(ans, dp[j])
            dp[j + 1] = add(dp[j + 1], dp[j])
            j += 1
        i += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
